name: Chicken with Mustard Cream Sauce & Spinach Salad

instructions.primary_message: Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Slice chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Season with salt and pepper on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
340 g chicken breasts, boneless skinless
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add oil to skillet and swirl to coat bottom. Add chicken and cook until browned and cooked through, 2-3 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate.
Once chicken has been transferred, reduce heat to medium. Add more oil and shallot; cook, stirring frequently, until softened, 2-3 minutes.
Add broth and vinegar; scrape skillet to loosen any browned bits. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the liquid is reduced by about half, 4-5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
118 ml chicken or vegetable broth
2 tbsp white wine vinegar

instructions.primary_message: Add Dijon and oil; stir until well combined and continue cooking for 1-2 minutes. Remove from heat and season with salt and freshly ground pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp Dijon mustard
virgin coconut oil
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: To serve, arrange spinach and chicken on a plate; drizzle with mustard sauce and enjoy!
